description: This file contains test utilities and mock implementations for the openclaw acpx runtime, including mock CLI script generation, log reading, and fixture cleanup functions.

methods.name: createMockRuntimeFixture
methods.description: Creates a mock AcpxRuntime instance with test configuration, sets up log file path, and returns runtime, log path, and config.

methods.name: readMockRuntimeLogEntries
methods.description: Reads and parses log entries from the mock runtime log file.

methods.name: cleanupMockRuntimeFixtures
methods.description: Cleans up environment variables and temporary directories used by mock fixtures.
